sections.title: Overview
sections.body: Digital Risk Assessments replace rigid templates with tailored forms shaped around your hazard model. Office superintendents design assessments, assign vessels and superintendents by group, and track fleet-wide status — while vessel crews complete assessments offline with automatic sync when connectivity returns.
bullets: Custom risk assessment builder for your operating model
Auto-alerting when hazard levels cross defined thresholds
Easy search across assessments, vessels, and review history
Analytics dashboard with Excel and PDF export
Live demo available upon request

flowchart LR
  Office -.-> Build[Custom RA]
  Vessel -.-> Complete[Complete RA]
  Build -.-> Fleet[Fleet library]
  Complete -.-> Fleet

sections.title: Office & vessel roles
sections.body: Two primary roles — office side and vessel side — each with permissions tuned to how superintendents and crews actually work. Office users create and publish assessments, manage users and vessels, assign superintendents by vessel group, and oversee reviews. Vessel users execute assessments, attach evidence, and sign off with pen or digital signature.
bullets: Office: create assessments, assign vessels, manage users
Vessel: complete assessments, sign, sync offline
Superintendent assignment by vessel group
User and vessel management in one place
Auto-serialization across the assessment lifecycle

flowchart TD

  V -.-> Sign
  Create -.-> Review
  Review -.-> Close

sections.title: Platform & licensing
sections.body: Deploy on our cloud or your own infrastructure with your branding. Authentication uses SSO on your tenant with company-specific preferences. Licence as a one-time payment or subscription — with no limit on seats. Review workflows and risk assessment templates are included in the package.
bullets: Company branding and self-hosted deployment options
SSO authentication on your tenant
One-time or subscription licensing — unlimited seats
Automatic digital auditing and timestamping on every action
Data migration from legacy risk tools
Fine-tuned with superintendents and captains for usability and compliance

sections.title: Reviews & outputs
sections.body: Each assessment carries its own review chatroom so office and vessel teams resolve questions in context. Search finds assessments by vessel, hazard, status, or superintendent. Analytics surfaces trends; Excel and PDF printouts support audits and management reporting.
bullets: Dedicated chatroom per risk assessment
Configurable review workflows included in package

Excel and PDF export for audits

sections.title: Overview
sections.body: Our Behaviour Based Safety software follows international BBS practice — proactive observation, positive reinforcement, and data-driven intervention. Vessel crews and office teams use the same programme with dynamic ICP forms that support file attachments, threaded comments, and red flags for urgent conditions.
bullets: Built on international BBS standards
Vessel and office roles with aligned permissions
Dynamic ICP forms — not static paper cards
File attachments on observations
Red flags for immediate escalation

sections.title: ICP forms & culture
sections.body: ICP forms adapt to your behaviour categories, locations, and vessel types. Observers record safe and at-risk behaviours, attach photos or documents, and add comments for context. Red flags route severe observations to the right approvers without losing the non-punitive culture BBS depends on.
bullets: Configurable behaviour categories and locations
Comments on every observation
File attachments for evidence
Red flag routing for urgent items
Stop-work and hazard observation support

sections.title: Overview
sections.body: SDR (Stevedore Damage Report) covers the full flow when stevedoring damage occurs on vessel — from first notice through documentation, sign-on, office review, and financial close-out. Replace fragmented email and paper with one auditable record.

sections.title: Vessel to office flow
sections.body: The master or chief officer records damage with photos and witness notes. A digital printout supports stevedore sign-on or documented refusal. Office teams review in context, discuss in the case chatroom, and route for superintendent or commercial approval.

Digital and pen signature on printout

Office review queue with status tracking
Dedicated chatroom per damage report
